digest.component_or_area: binding store and GET rotation reconciler
propositions: Introduce a rotation module that manages fail-open sidecar load/save and uses max(sidecar_value, legacy_inline_value) for each Jira key, dual-writing every new stamp to both the sidecar and legacy inline field during rollout.
Persist the sidecar only through BindingStore.save() covering end-of-pass, write-ahead, recovery, and retirement save paths, while reconcile-check uses persist=False and never triggers persistence.
An idempotent pass with no absent-key GETs leaves all committed bridge-state files byte-identical and does not advance HEAD after rotation state is initialized.
A pass with at most 20 absent-key GETs advances the same selected Jira-key stamps in both get_rotation.json and legacy inline fields, committing both files without git add -A.
An interleaved old-binary/new-binary pass sequence produces the same rotation order as an all-new sequence, and legacy inline-only stores preserve and migrate rotation order on next persisted save.

Explicit local binding-store commit path stages and commits both rotation files; outbound_differ.py remains at or below 800 lines; GET_ROTATION_FILE constant and regenerable-files documentation are present.
